column1: United Way of the Coastal Empire 211
column2: Chatham, Bryan, Effingham, Liberty and Long counties
column5: Call 211 and give your ZIP code and the kind of help you need. Ask which local providers are taking referrals and what to bring.

column1: Second Harvest of Coastal Georgia – Find Food
column2: Chatham County and coastal Georgia; each food pantry sets its own service area
column5: Search the map for a food pantry near your ZIP code. Confirm hours, documents and whether you need an appointment.

column1: Georgia Gateway – benefits applications
column2: Georgia residents, including Chatham County; program rules apply
column5: Use Georgia Gateway to apply for SNAP food assistance, Medicaid or other listed benefits, or to check an existing case.

column1: Chatham Savannah Authority for the Homeless – local resource directory
column2: Savannah and Chatham County; intake depends on the local provider
column5: Use the directory to find shelter or housing support. Confirm current intake, and call 211 if you need help finding a provider.

column1: City of Savannah – Housing Assistance and Applications
column2: Housing within Savannah city limits only; program rules apply
column5: Choose the relevant program for housing repair, purchase or homelessness assistance. Confirm city limits, eligibility and whether applications are open.

column1: Economic Opportunity Authority – LIHEAP and energy assistance
column2: Savannah and Chatham County; confirm program eligibility and funding
column5: Look for LIHEAP under energy assistance. Ask when appointments open and which documents to bring for help with home energy bills.

column1: Chatham County Health Department – Eisenhower Clinic
column2: Chatham County public health; service eligibility varies
column5: Call the Eisenhower Clinic to confirm the location and schedule an appointment for the health service you need. The clinic is at 1395 Eisenhower Drive, Savannah, GA 31406.

column1: Chatham County Health Department – WIC referrals and appointments
column2: Chatham County; WIC eligibility rules apply
column5: Ask either Chatham clinic about an appointment for WIC nutrition support for eligible pregnant or postpartum people, infants and young children.

column1: Gateway Community Service Board – Chatham Same Day Access
column2: Chatham County access site; confirm program and appointment details
column5: Look for Chatham Same Day Access and confirm current intake hours for mental health or substance use treatment and what to bring.

column1: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
column2: United States, including Chatham County
column5: Call or text 988, or use the website chat, for crisis support.

column1: SAFE Shelter domestic violence support
column2: Savannah area; confidential domestic violence intake
column5: If you can use a safe device, call the crisis line to speak with an advocate and ask about a safe next step.

column1: Georgia Legal Services Program – civil legal aid
column2: Chatham County and other service counties outside metro Atlanta; eligibility applies
column5: Follow the intake instructions for civil legal help. Mention any court date, eviction notice or other deadline at the start.

column1: Chatham Area Transit – service schedules and trip planning
column2: Savannah, unincorporated Chatham County and parts of Garden City; check route coverage
column5: Look up your bus route and direction. Check current detours, the last return trip and fare before leaving.

column1: Chatham Area Transit – CAT Mobility paratransit
column2: Eligible riders in the Chatham Area Transit service area
column5: Read the CAT Mobility eligibility and application instructions. Confirm approval and advance booking requirements before relying on a ride.

column1: WorkSource Coastal – job and training assistance
column2: Chatham County and other WorkSource Coastal counties; program rules apply
column5: Find the Chatham Job Center and ask about job search, career counseling or training and whether to make an appointment.

column1: Live Oak Public Libraries – computers and Wi-Fi
column2: Participating Live Oak Public Library branches, including Chatham County
column5: Check public computer and Wi-Fi access rules, then confirm hours and what you need for computer use at your branch.

column1: Renegade CAN – pet food pantry
column2: Savannah-area pet owners; confirm current distribution and availability
column5: Check the pet food pantry information before going. Ask when the next pickup is and whether supplies are available.

column1: Georgia Department of Veterans Service – Savannah
column2: Veterans and eligible family members in Chatham County
column5: Use the Savannah office listing to contact a veterans benefits representative. Ask what documents you need before visiting.

column1: Economic Opportunity Authority – VITA tax help
column2: Savannah-Chatham area; program eligibility and dates apply
column5: Check whether free tax preparation is available for your filing needs. Confirm the current schedule and ask which documents to bring.

column1: United Way of the Coastal Empire – volunteer opportunities
column2: Chatham, Bryan, Effingham, Liberty and Long counties
column5: Review local volunteer opportunities and ask the organizer about scheduling, eligibility and orientation.

column1: Chatham Emergency Management Agency – weather and emergency alerts
column2: Chatham County
column5: Use the official CEMA Alerts sign-up link for weather and emergency notices in Chatham County.
